import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):

    return (params[0]*P + params[1]*P*L + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]
            + params[4]*t + params[5]*t**2 + params[6]*t**3 + params[7]*t*P + params[8]*t**2*P + params[9]*t*P*L)
